text: 污染风偏移，轨道占用异常，货仓回声频率上升。结论：麻烦正在加速靠近。建议半吊子列车长提前表现得像个列车长。

speaker: 波克士
text: 波克士投出行车图：“全知者波克士已完成准备，半吊子列车长只需照做。”

speaker: 列车长
text: 波克士，如果我需要你临时接管一部分行车协议，你能撑多久？

speaker: 波克士
text: 哔哔！请注意措辞。不是“撑”，是“由伟大的波克士降临并拯救局面”。

speaker: 列车长
text: 那伟大的波克士能降临多久？

speaker: 波克士
text: 视列车长添乱程度而定。理想状态二十七分钟，现实状态约十五分钟。

speaker: 列车长
text: 够了。

speaker: 波克士
text: 另外，莉薇娅小姐要求本机提醒您：十五分钟不是让您冲进危险区域的许可证。

speaker: 列车长
text: 你们两个什么时候统一口径的？

speaker: 波克士
text: 优秀个体之间不需要统一口径。半吊子列车长只需要听话。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 护卫乘员 / 负责把艾略特拉回工作

speaker: 弗兰
text: 弗兰检查盾牌固定带，提醒你别把护卫排班当成无限资源。

speaker: 列车长
text: 弗兰，护卫排班还能压缩吗？

speaker: 弗兰
text: 能。但不建议。能压缩和应该压缩不是一回事。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 我觉得可以适度相信同伴的主观能动性，比如让我主观地去休息。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 你刚才已经休息过了。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 那叫战略性闭目养神。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 列车长，后段我来巡一次，艾略特补货仓门口。她再战略性闭眼，你可以直接扣她餐后甜点。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 这也太严厉了吧！

speaker: 弗兰
text: 弗兰看了一眼艾略特，又看向你：“我会守住前段，她守后段。”

speaker: 列车长
text: 弗兰，今天辛苦你盯着艾略特了。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 这算工作内容的一部分。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 我抗议，我明明也有可靠的时候。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 通常发生在已经没有时间给你找借口的时候。

speaker: 列车长
text: 那如果今晚出事，你觉得她靠得住吗？

speaker: 弗兰
text: 靠得住。前提是别让她提前知道要加班太久。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 我本人就在旁边，你们可以稍微委婉一点。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 弗兰把巡逻表按到桌上：“这次我来排。艾略特不许抗议。”

speaker: 列车长
text: 弗兰，如果要在风暴边界外守一整晚，你怎么排？

speaker: 弗兰
text: 我守前半，艾略特守后半。列车长休息，莉薇娅也休息。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 等一下，为什么我的名字出现得这么自然？

speaker: 弗兰
text: 因为你关键时候不会跑。

speaker: 艾略特
text: ……你突然这么说，我反而不好意思偷懒了。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 那就记住现在的不好意思。

speaker: 列车长
text: 我把这句写进值乘记录。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 别！这会成为以后压榨我的证据！

speaker: 艾略特
text: 护卫乘员 / 嘴碎、偷懒、关键时刻会动

speaker: 艾略特
text: 艾略特举手：“我能申请一个比较不累的信任增长方式吗？”

speaker: 列车长
text: 艾略特，你在这里做什么？

speaker: 艾略特
text: 观察餐车门口的安全环境。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 她在等夜宵。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 安全环境里包含夜宵，这很合理。

speaker: 列车长
text: 货仓门口需要人。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 我就知道。列车长，你说话前停顿半秒的时候，通常没有好事。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 走。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 走就走。我先声明，我这是为了列车，不是为了被扣甜点。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 艾略特叹了口气：“好吧好吧，我去后段。弗兰你别用那种眼神看我。”

speaker: 列车长
text: 艾略特，后段情况怎么样？

speaker: 艾略特
text: 黑、冷、离餐车远。总结完毕。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 异常情况。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 哦对，还有箱子响了两次。我本来想第一时间汇报，结果弗兰已经用眼神把我钉在门口了。

speaker: 列车长
text: 你听见的声音像什么？

speaker: 艾略特
text: 像有人在箱子里敲节拍。很轻，但不太友好。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 这句有用。前面那些可以删掉。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 艾略特一边喊累，一边把备用弹匣塞进腰包：“我知道啦，关键时候不会掉链子的。”

speaker: 列车长
text: 艾略特，如果今晚需要你和弗兰一起压到最危险的车厢，你会抱怨吗？

speaker: 艾略特
text: 会。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 她会边抱怨边去。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 别抢答。虽然答案确实是这个。

speaker: 列车长
text: 为什么？

speaker: 艾略特
text: 因为我要是不去，弗兰会一个人去。然后我就会被她回来之后的眼神教育三天。

speaker: 弗兰
text: 不止三天。

speaker: 艾略特
text: 你看，所以我还是去吧。列车长，记得给我写一句“表现英勇但需要补休”。
准点交付
列车按合同抵达并交付部件。商会信用提升，报酬完整到账。
只是异常记录被压到附录里。莉薇娅完成了账目，却在最后一页留下空白。
延期复核
列车放弃准点奖励，申请由遥与维护方共同复核货物状态。
无垠号多进了一次维修仓，但现实稳定装置避免了一次带病接入。
责任公开
莉薇娅整理的责任链、遥的技术记录和波克士的行车日志共同组成了完整报告。
商会追责没有立刻消失，但这一次，列车组没有让风险被漂亮账目埋掉。
铁盟托管
货物被交由铁盟临时托管，列车获得安全撤离许可。
奖励不算漂亮，但静流在记录里写下了“建议放行，但保持关注”。
压线完成
波克士用应急协议压线完成交接，随后进入检修模式。
它的最后一条播报是：本机表现无可挑剔，列车长表现仍待观察。
风暴停驶
无垠号没能抵达交付终端。列车停在风暴边界外，等待救援与维修。
这不是漂亮结局，但没有人被丢下。莉薇娅把未完成的记录夹进账本，说明天一起补。

speaker: Narration
text: Morning at Freeport VII is never truly quiet. Cargo arms still move beneath the track bridge, and the broadcast keeps reminding passengers to stay away from the temporary cordon toward the contamination zone.

speaker: Narration
text: The Eternal sits at the third maintenance trestle. The train has not departed, but the cargo hold already contains a deep-blue case sealed with lead. Its label reads: Anita Energy Institute, Reality Stabilization Component, Short-Range Express.

speaker: Me
text: Short range, express pay, higher than usual, and we carry liability for any damage before delivery. That does not sound like a good job.

speaker: Livia
text: The format is correct, and the seals are correct. That is exactly why I am uneasy. Conductor, if anything is wrong with this commission, you will be the first one they hold responsible.

speaker: BOX
text: Beep beep! The great BOX confirms: the half-baked Conductor's nose for trouble has finally approached the crew average.

speaker: Eliot
text: Can we raise that average a little higher by refusing outright? Personally, I fully support a safe, comfortable business model with fewer guard shifts.

speaker: Fran
text: You support fewer guard shifts, not safety. Conductor, the hold seal has not been forced open, but there are fresh scratches around the outer ring.

speaker: Haruka
text: The undercarriage dislikes it.

speaker: Me
text: Haruka, you mean the box?

speaker: Haruka
text: Mm. It is echoing.

speaker: Narration
text: Livia closes her clipboard, then opens it again almost immediately. It is what she does when she wants to urge caution but is still searching for a way not to cross the line.

speaker: Livia
text: The destination is the outer Shoggolith maintenance line. Under normal conditions, we could arrive in three days, but the weather station just updated the contamination storm warning. We have a seven-day window. After that, the entire maintenance line closes.

speaker: Me
text: So the question is not whether we deliver it. It is how, where, and when we admit this has stopped being an ordinary commission.

speaker: BOX
text: Excellent summary. BOX recommends awarding the Conductor one point for comprehension today. Total score remains unimpressive.

speaker: Narration
text: The departure bell rings for the first time. The Eternal's light strips wake one after another, like a small city opening its eyes. You still have a moment to decide what the first driving record will say.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: The wind shifts quickly along the outer edge of Freeport VII. Static in the platform broadcast scrapes across your ears like fine sand.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: The contract itself has no visible flaw, but it is too clean. Clean enough to feel like someone wiped away the parts we should have seen.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: Beep beep! Before signing, BOX recommends fluid intake: black tea, water, or the courage to admit you are nervous.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: If the great BOX has time for tea advice, give me the cargo scan.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: Cargo scan complete. Result: annoyingly normal. Interpretation: suspiciously normal.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: The insurance clause is folded. That usually means someone read it more than once.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: Or wanted us not to.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Caroline
text: The route listed here crosses the storm margin directly. It is the shortest line, not the kindest one.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: If we depart as written, we keep schedule and Chamber credit. If we delay, we may find why the paperwork is hiding its own pulse.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: Summary: the Conductor must choose between punctual recklessness and time-consuming paranoia. BOX endorses the paranoia with style.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: A departure chime rings overhead. The sealed cargo case waits on the track lift, polished, silent, and wrong.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: All right. Before The Eternal moves, we choose what kind of record we are writing.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Depart strictly according to the contract
choice_hint: Protect schedule and Chamber credit, but ignore the accounting discrepancy.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Depart strictly according to the contract
speaker: Livia
text: I will log it according to the contract. But Conductor, "no anomaly" and "no risk" are not the same thing.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Depart strictly according to the contract
speaker: BOX
text: Record: half-baked Conductor chose to trust words on paper. BOX reserves the right to complain later.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have Livia recheck the commission accounts
choice_hint: Spend time to gain clues and open Livia's accounting route.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have Livia recheck the commission accounts
speaker: Livia
text: There is a crease in the insurance clause. It says if the component fails before delivery, liability shifts to the carrier.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have Livia recheck the commission accounts
speaker: Narration
text: She does not say "danger." She only circles the line with a pencil, gently enough that it feels worse.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Hear Caroline's detour advice
choice_hint: Spend fuel to reduce storm-border risk.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Hear Caroline's detour advice
speaker: Caroline
text: I am not saying the map is wrong. I am saying today's road does not quite look like the road on the map.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Hear Caroline's detour advice
speaker: BOX
text: Beep beep. Intuition-based navigation recorded. Accuracy unknown. Conviction annoyingly high.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: The sealed cargo crates answer the track vibration with a low resonance, like equipment that has not yet woken up.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Haruka
text: Undercarriage sensors are being disturbed.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Eliot
text: Before departure? Can I apply to start being serious tomorrow?

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Fran
text: No. Stand guard.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Eliot
text: You answer too fast. It hurts the spirit.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Haruka
text: The cargo is echoing.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: Cargo does not usually echo back.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Haruka
text: This one does.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: The manifest calls it a reality stabilization component. The container label calls it inert.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: BOX notes that humans use "inert" most often right before something moves.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: The hold lights tremble. A thin line of dust slides from one crate seam and stops exactly at Haruka's boot.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: We either inspect properly, guard properly, or leave fast enough to make the problem tomorrow's problem.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let Haruka open up the sensor assembly
choice_hint: Improve train condition and gain clues, at the cost of schedule.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let Haruka open up the sensor assembly
speaker: Haruka
text: Not loose. The cargo is answering the train.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let Haruka open up the sensor assembly
speaker: Narration
text: She turns back under the carriage after saying it, leaving only the maintenance lamp swaying behind her.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Assign Fran and Eliot to guard the hold
choice_hint: Reduce risk and raise morale, but spend supplies.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Assign Fran and Eliot to guard the hold
speaker: Fran
text: I take the front section. Eliot takes the rear.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Assign Fran and Eliot to guard the hold
speaker: Eliot
text: The rear? That is farthest from the dining car, right? Can I request a more humane position?

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Assign Fran and Eliot to guard the hold
speaker: Fran
text: No.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have BOX run the fast-departure procedure
choice_hint: Recover schedule, but strain the train and BOX's stability.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have BOX run the fast-departure procedure
speaker: BOX
text: Navigator BOX initiates fast procedure. Conductor, please refrain from looking relieved when this superior unit performs as expected.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Have BOX run the fast-departure procedure
speaker: Haruka
text: Fast is fast. It will ring later.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: The Eternal leaves Freeport VII's outer lights behind. Outside the window, black grassland swallows the last platform glow.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: Low-frequency Anita-format return detected. Content damaged. Source highly correlated with the cargo batch.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: Conductor, there is another line in the account appendix. I think we should not wait until arrival to read it.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: Read it.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Livia
text: If the cargo is damaged by storm-border anomaly before delivery, all chain liability may be assigned to the carrier.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Eliot
text: That sounds like someone wrote a trap and then gave it a polite tie.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Fran
text: Focus.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Haruka
text: The floor changed pitch.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Me
text: How bad?

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Haruka
text: Not bad yet. Listening.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: BOX
text: Recommendation: decode, inspect, or rest. BOX notes that ignoring sleep is the Conductor's most boring self-sabotage.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
speaker: Narration
text: The route map glows above the desk. Three choices cast three different shadows across the account book.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Check the appendix with Livia
choice_hint: Gain key clues, but increase fatigue.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Check the appendix with Livia
speaker: Livia
text: If the cargo fails due to a storm-border anomaly, the carrier absorbs the liability. Conductor, this is not an ordinary order.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Check the appendix with Livia
speaker: Narration
text: She pushes the tea toward your hand. Her fingertip remains on the clause about responsibility.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Ask Haruka about the cargo hold
choice_hint: Improve technical confidence, but spend the night working.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Ask Haruka about the cargo hold
speaker: Haruka
text: The container is not dead. It is waiting for a vibration it recognizes.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Ask Haruka about the cargo hold
speaker: Me
text: Can you keep it from recognizing us?

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let BOX decode automatically while you rest
choice_hint: Recover fatigue and gain a clue, but BOX dislikes being used as a silent appliance.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let BOX decode automatically while you rest
speaker: BOX
text: The incomparable BOX accepts this menial task under protest. Please sleep efficiently.

day_title: Freeport VII, the Account Before Departure
choice_title: Let BOX decode automatically while you rest
speaker: Narration
text: The lights dim. BOX's decoding tone continues like a very proud lullaby.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Narration
text: By morning, an Anita institute dock rises from the mist like a rib of pale metal.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Broadcast
text: Carrier train The Eternal, please accept temporary technical verification. Repeat, temporary technical verification.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Livia
text: They used the word temporary twice. That usually means they know it will not be.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Researcher
text: The component you carry matches an old stabilization sample. We only need a short stop.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: BOX
text: Translation: they need more than a short stop and less than permission.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Me
text: What happens if we refuse?

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Researcher
text: Nothing formal. But the storm margin ahead may become difficult to model.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Haruka
text: They have data. The train wants it.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Eliot
text: The train wants things now? Great. Does it want my shift too?

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Fran
text: No one wants your shift.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Livia
text: Stopping gives us answers. Moving keeps the contract clean. Either choice leaves a mark.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Narration
text: The institute bridge extends halfway, then waits, as if it knows hesitation is also a kind of consent.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Refuse docking and keep the original route
choice_hint: Protect schedule and credit, but lose a clue and raise risk.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Refuse docking and keep the original route
speaker: Researcher
text: Understood. We will record that The Eternal declined verification.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Refuse docking and keep the original route
speaker: Livia
text: They said that too calmly. I do not like calm records written by other people.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Dock briefly and accept only the data packet
choice_hint: Trade schedule, fuel, and credit for clues.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Dock briefly and accept only the data packet
speaker: Haruka
text: Data received. It is incomplete, but useful.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Dock briefly and accept only the data packet
speaker: BOX
text: Useful and incomplete: the official motto of human cooperation.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Full dock and help recover the sample data
choice_hint: Gain strong clues, but spend time, fuel, and Chamber credit.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Full dock and help recover the sample data
speaker: Researcher
text: Thank you, Conductor. The sample has been misbehaving since it entered your train's field.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
choice_title: Full dock and help recover the sample data
speaker: Haruka
text: It is not misbehaving. It is scared.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Narration
text: By afternoon, every power gauge in the cab looks slightly more nervous than it should.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Haruka
text: If you keep running like this, the current power system will not support it.

day_title: Anita Energy Institute, Samples and Output
speaker: Me

On-Time Delivery
The train arrives and delivers the component according to contract. Chamber credit rises, and the full reward clears.
The anomaly record is pushed into an appendix. Livia finishes the account, but leaves the final page blank.
Delayed Review
The train gives up the schedule bonus and requests a joint review between Haruka and the maintenance side.
The Eternal enters the repair bay one extra time, but the reality stabilizer avoids being connected while still wounded.
Liability Exposed
Livia's liability chain, Haruka's technical record, and BOX's driving log become one complete report.
Chamber pressure does not vanish, but this time the crew refuses to let risk be buried under clean accounts.
BCRL Custody
The cargo is placed under temporary BCRL custody, and the train receives clearance to withdraw safely.
The reward is not pretty, but Shizuru writes, "Recommend passage, maintain observation" into the record.
Line-Border Completion
BOX uses emergency protocol to complete the handoff on the line, then drops into maintenance mode.
